snippet.title: Chinese Frontiers – Official Trailer | FULL RELEASE June 19, 2025 (Steam)
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam 👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640820/Chinese_Frontiers/

Chinese Frontiers is a builder and survival game where the player rises from a humble villager to a master builder, constructing parts of the Great Wall of China and other iconic landmarks.

🎮 Coming to Steam on June 19, 2025

🔗 Join our community
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/NhSSztvEWG

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chinese_frontiers/
Website & Press Kit: https://chinesefrontiers.com/
